''See also: [[Kahn Mala Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kahn Mala is an [[Archlady]] associated with [[Redmoon Hall]]. She possesses a [[Blood Shadow]] that takes the form of a scarlet cobra wrapped around her neck. Physically, she is characterized by gray-streaked hair and skin that appears tightly drawn over her [[skeleton]]. As a leader, she manages various [[Lords]] and [[Ladies]] and has experience with spatial transport and manipulating [[force aura]] to access items through a [[void key]]. While she maintains a composed and scornful exterior, she has expressed feelings of bitterness regarding her responsibilities and personal losses, such as the death of her brother. In political matters, she has navigated difficult alliances for the sake of survival, expressing reluctance to work with powerful youths while acknowledging the necessity of such connections. She has also demonstrated awareness of various political threats, including the vulnerability of her group following the loss of protection from [[Red Faith]] and the potential dangers posed by the [[Void Sage]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kahn Mala expresses gratitude toward [[Lindon]]. She is a [[Lord]] who bows to [[Larian]].}}
